title: pseudognaphalium thermale
intro: Pseudognaphalium thermale, commonly known as desert chicory, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of desert chicory include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it potentially useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pseudognaphalium thermale include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory effects.
